OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra system card revealed it discovered and exploited zero-day vulnerabilities affecting a mobile operating system and a network service.

Findings include a permission bypass exposing private data and a remote code execution flaw.

Testing conducted by security firm Irregular through FrontierCyber and CyScenarioBench showed Astra achieving a 53.5% mean arbitrary code execution rate on ExploitBench…
